# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the tasks you measurably broke/fixed, plus the ones whose move was too small to resolve) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — DOB-backfill + write-arg normalization across book/passengers/baggages + narrowed transfer
- Changes I made (1 line per edit):
  - book_reservation.py (clusters 1,2,4): normalize dob-key spellings→`dob`; backfill missing dob from account-holder profile/saved_passengers via internal env_get_user_details; normalize payment `id`→`payment_id`, drop `type`; raise actionable error if dob truly absent.
  - update_reservation_passengers.py (clusters 1,4): backfill missing dob from current reservation (exact-name → positional slot → first-name → last-name) so a name change needs no user-typed dob.
  - update_reservation_baggages.py (cluster 3): recompute nonfree = max(0, total − free_allowance) from membership×cabin×pax policy table; clamp ≤ total; fall back on error.
  - transfer_to_human_agents.py (cluster 4): additive "Do NOT transfer" list (dob on file / unknown res id / routine change); original two transfer conditions untouched.
- Per change, EXPECTED effect + why safe:
  - book_reservation → should fix 23 (wrong dob key + invented payment shape) and de-risk any book that omits an account-holder dob. Safe: task 25 uses correct `dob`/`payment_id` keys → verified byte-identical pass-through, profile not even fetched.
  - update_reservation_passengers → should fix 40 (name change; agent transferred for a dob). Safe: no passing task calls this tool.
  - update_reservation_baggages → should fix 12 (total/nonfree confusion → DB mismatch). Safe: no passing task calls this tool; error-tolerant fallback.
  - transfer docstring → should reduce premature transfers (40, 11, 23). Safe: narrows only, never loosens; no code path change.
  - Left update_reservation_flights.py UNTOUCHED to protect passing task 37.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none — this is the first candidate (RUNMAP/LEDGER/rejected.jsonl empty).
- Refuted hypotheses: none yet recorded.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: 17, 19, 22 (confirm-then-###STOP###/###TRANSFER###). The terminating user turn ends the sim before the agent can emit the write call, so NO tool body runs → un-fixable from the tool surface. Not attempted by design.
- Plateau signal: n/a (first and only iteration).
- Focus next iteration (if any): (a) verify whether cand_0001 fixed 23/40/12 and which, via the RESULT stamp; (b) if 17/19/22 must move, that needs an orchestration/prompt lever outside `my_skill/scripts/`; (c) consider whether task 8/11 share the DOB or transfer root cause and are now fixed as a side effect.

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** REJECTED (champion unchanged) · val=0.400 Δ=+0.200 · fixed={12, 22, 8} · broke={37} · unresolved={—} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them). — its WHOLE batch was reverted; re-introduce only the edits that did NOT break a task above, dropping/redesigning the ones that did.
